action.action-desc: Mr. Harrigan introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To amend title XIX of the Social Security Act to exclude certain gambling winnings from monthly income under the community engagement requirement under the Medicaid program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the No Gambling for Medicaid Act.

section.header: Exclusion of certain gambling winnings from monthly income under community engagement requirement for applicable individuals
section.text: Section 1902(xx) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396a(xx)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (2)(F), by inserting , excluding covered gambling winnings, after monthly income;
in paragraph (2)(G), by inserting , excluding covered gambling winnings, after monthly income; and
in paragraph (9), by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

clause.text: The term covered gambling winnings means any prize, award, or income derived from a bet or wager, except a bet or wager that is engaged in as a trade or business activity.
For purposes of clause (i), the term bet or wager has the meaning given such term in section 5362 of title 31, United States Code.
For purposes of clause (i), the term trade or business activity means an activity that an individual engages in—

subclause.text: for the primary purpose of income or profit; and
